description: VYBE Music v4.1.3 — Listen Together Beat Sync Same-Time Precision & Bass Boost, In-App Update Dialog with changelogs on home page, Admin portal cleanup & operator email fix, and host-only song stability.
changelog: Listen Together Beat Sync Same-Time Accuracy: Tightly tuned drift thresholds (120ms snap seek, 20ms micro-adjust) and 1s high-precision heartbeats ensure both phones play at the exact same millisecond with zero audible echo
Listen Together Beat Sync Bass Boost: Hardware-accelerated low-frequency bass boost synchronized across connected phones for powerful, punchy party sound
Dedicated Bass Boost toggles in Room Controls and Settings for both Host and Guest listeners
In-App Update Dialog: Automatic home page update popup displaying App Name (VYBE Music), version number, and structured bullet-point changelogs
Two-Action Update Control: 'Update Now' navigates directly to the updater screen for instant download, while 'Later' cleanly dismisses the dialog for the session
Admin Portal Cleanup: Cleaned up Admin screen by removing the registration guide card for a streamlined administrative workflow
Admin Email Filter Fix: Portal operator email (admin@vybemusic.app) is strictly filtered out from the Registered Members list and metrics
Rich Google Member Cards: Displays Google profile avatar, display name, verified Google badge, registered email, and active device indicator
Listen Together Song Stability: Heartbeat timestamp updates are strictly isolated from track change events to eliminate song tug-of-war bouncing
Listen Together Host-Only Control: When enabled by host, guest play/pause/skip actions are blocked with a polite toast notification
Smart Sleep Timer: Redesigned dialog with clear end-of-song option and gentle 30-second volume fade-out
Zero Lag Performance Optimization: Pre-cached viewmodels and lazy component rendering ensure smooth 60fps scrolling
